chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, when it was a day on which he would fast, would order for a sheep to be slaughtered, its limbs cut up, and it cooked.

Then when it was evening, he would bend over the cooking pots until he found the smell of the broth while he was fasting, then he would say: “Bring the bowls. Serve for the family of so-and-so; serve for the family of so-and-so.”
Then bread and dates would be brought, and that would be his evening meal.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام combine fasting with feeding others?
ai.summary: This report describes the practice of Imam Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام in combining fasting with generosity toward others. He would prepare food for households and personally suffice with simple bread and dates, showing charity, restraint, and care for the needy.
